title: Data Science Knowledge Base
text:
Some of these documents do not belong here, but whilst this is a “knowledge sharing base”, I first wanted to try and collate as many “loose ends” as possible to then decide as a team what we should do with them.
For example, the scrollytelling slides are “look at this nice thing we made” portfolio pieces rather than learning resources.
